note: The old estimator and the harmonized estimator use exactly the same prior cases and the same relation-population weights N_r/N. For the 12 sampled runs this reconstructs the stratified estimator, not the unweighted success fraction among 100 cases. For the two old complete evaluations it is the exact top-20 census fraction; extra subsidiary cases are excluded. The full census uses every fact. Ambiguity endpoints are descriptive; no sampling confidence intervals are added here.

prior.label: unit or subsidiary of
prior.definition: The first organization is an owned subsidiary, division, or organizational unit of the second.
prior.scope_notes: The dominant part/unit/owned-by paths jointly specify organizational containment in the subsidiary-to-parent direction, as in the earlier audit. An acquisition offer alone is insufficient; mere collaboration is excluded.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
current.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

prior.label: analyst affiliation
prior.definition: The first person works as an analyst for or at the second organization.
prior.scope_notes: Analyst-for/with/at overwhelmingly dominates. Director or partner alone does not establish analyst status. A shared analyst path does not resolve incompatible names within one latent entity.

current.label: analyst at organization
current.definition: Person X works or worked as an analyst for organization Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit analyst at/for/with/of; following or tracking an industry or companies for an employer when it identifies professional analysis. Excludes: director/president/professor/scientist/spokesperson/editor/lawyer/partner alone; generic affiliation. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: economist-only, forecaster, strategist or specialist at the analyst role boundary; unclear role/employer attachment. Preserves the earlier full-census A boundary for nearby financial roles; do not silently label all financial employment analyst.

prior.label: coach of
prior.definition: The first person coaches or coached the second team or institutional sports program.
prior.scope_notes: Coach-of/possessive and active coaching dominate. Historical coaching is included. Considering a vacancy alone, general management, political participation and athletic participation without coaching are excluded.

current.label: coach of
current.definition: Person X coaches or coached sports team or collegiate athletic program Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit coach title; direct coaching with correct subject and team; former/dismissed coach with clear office evidence; team/university shorthand when the athletic program role is clear. Excludes: manager/president/player alone; winning with a team alone; vacancy consideration alone; reverse team-to-coach direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: missing coach subject or team attachment.

prior.label: defeated opponent
prior.definition: The first competitor won a contest against the second competitor.
prior.scope_notes: Defeat/victory/sweep form the dominant winning family when grouped; lose-to is the strongest individual competing path and has the opposite direction. Mere participation or a margin/lead without an established victory is excluded. Wins and losses in different historical contests may coexist; one explicit win suffices.

current.label: defeated opponent
current.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
current.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

prior.label: director of
prior.definition: The first person is or was a director of the second organization.
prior.scope_notes: The director family clearly dominates the full dictionary, matching the earlier specific-director scope. President/head/chief, analyst, founder or performer alone do not substitute for an explicit directorship. Broader leadership would be an alternative predicate, not an automatic union.

current.label: director of organization
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit director office of, for or at organization or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit director/co-director; functional directorship such as communications or research director within Y; historical office. Excludes: head/president/chair/executive alone; spokesperson/adviser/publisher/professor/member alone; performing or authorship alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal with omitted organization; abstract topic in place of the actual institution. Does not require sole chief control of the entire institution.

prior.label: chairperson of
prior.definition: The first person is or was chairperson of the second organization.
prior.scope_notes: Chairman noun and possessive paths and chairmanship succession dominate. Historical, resigning or retiring chairpersons are included. The smaller executive/founder family is competing evidence: an executive need not chair the organization. Do not widen this clear office to every managerial role.

current.label: chairperson of
current.definition: Person X holds or held the office of chair or chairperson of organization or governing body Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit chair/chairman/chairwoman/chairperson; co-chair if explicit; past tenure or resignation from that office. Excludes: president/head/executive/director alone; founder/owner/member alone; nomination/candidacy alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: ambiguous successor or appointment that does not establish tenure; chair of an omitted subunit. Do not widen a prior specific-chair declaration to managerial office because its facts would then score better.

prior.label: directed communication
prior.definition: The first person or institution communicates with, requests or urges action from, or advises the second.
prior.scope_notes: Ask/urge/persuade/tell/notify form the coherent dominant communication family used previously. Bare cooperation or replacement is excluded. Send-to without a recoverable communicative object can be ambiguous. Institutional recipients are permitted.

current.label: directed communication to
current.definition: Person or institution X directs information, speech, request, advice, warning or a message to addressee Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: tell/ask/urge/notify/advise/warn/persuade/address/speak-to; testimony before the addressee; send/submit a clearly communicative object; institutional communication through an identified representative. Excludes: mere meeting/cooperation/support; speaking about or criticizing Y without address; physical transfer; spokesperson intermediary treated as recipient. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: send/submit/give with omitted object and no other clear communication in this fact; person versus their administration or envoy attribution. An unqualified send-to edge does not by itself recover a message. Case-local corroboration may resolve it.

prior.label: chairs or heads organization
prior.definition: The first person holds or held the chair or head leadership office of the second organization or committee.
prior.scope_notes: Chairman/chair and head/lead together dominate the full dictionary. This is an office relationship, not generic membership: member/serve-on/sit-on form a substantial competing family. Historical offices count. Generic political descriptions require a resolved individual; chairmanship of a panel owned by a larger body does not alone establish chairmanship of that larger body.

current.label: chairs or heads organization
current.definition: Person X holds or held a chair or organizational head/leader office in organization or committee Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit chair/head/organizational leader; historical chair or head office. Excludes: ordinary member/serve-on/sit-on; generic executive/director/president without chair/head role; chair of a panel as proof of chairing its parent organization. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: incomplete panel/parent attachment; unnamed person identified only by party. This preserves the explicitly declared chair/head mixture in the latest review; it is narrower than managerial_office_in and must stay the same across cases.

prior.label: unit or subsidiary of
prior.definition: The first organization is an owned subsidiary, division, or organizational unit of the second.
prior.scope_notes: The dominant unit/subsidiary/owned-by dictionary has the same meaning as rel_250; different learned relation IDs do not require different invented predicates. Membership, speech, employment and completed deal descriptions without containment are not automatically equivalent.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
current.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

prior.label: economist affiliation
prior.definition: The first person works or worked as an economist for the second organization.
prior.scope_notes: Economist-for/at/of/with dominates, preserving the specific economist scope. President, director, analyst, specialist or forecaster alone is not sufficient. Historical employment counts; unrelated speech attachments remain competing evidence.

current.label: economist at organization
current.definition: Person X works or worked as an economist for or affiliated with organization Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit economist at/for/with/of; historical departmental economist affiliation. Excludes: analyst/strategist/specialist/professor/executive alone; generic financial expertise. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear economist/employer attachment.

prior.label: winner or champion of
prior.definition: The first entity won the competition or award designated by the second, or held its championship title.
prior.scope_notes: Win/champion/victory dominates. Preserve the earlier competition/award scope: historical wins and championship designations qualify, but participation, mere medal receipt without championship, winning an individual stage, and political officeholding do not. Winning the White House is a competing political meaning rather than an expansion of this predicate.

current.label: winner or champion of
current.definition: Entity X won the award or competition designated by Y, or held an explicitly Y-designated championship title.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit win/winner/champion of event or award; sporting titles and honor awards such as Nobel Peace Prize; explicit championship/title designated by a sanctioning body or Olympic designation; historical victory. Excludes: participation or reaching the event; single stage/game victory without the overall title; winning political office/control of a body; location or ordinary membership. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear title/event attachment; medal without a clear winning title or award scope. A named boxing body can designate its explicit title; mark broad_predicate rather than claiming the body itself was won. A named electoral competition is conceptually an event, but winning the White House or a legislature is office/control, not event-winning.

prior.label: director affiliation
prior.definition: The first person holds or held a director role of, for, or at the second organization.
prior.scope_notes: The director family overwhelmingly dominates, consistent with the specific-director scope of rel_263 and earlier reviews. Functional directors employed by an organization are included; this need not mean its sole overall leader. Professor, publisher, speaker, compiler or member alone is excluded. A truncated abstract topic requires identifying the intended institution.

current.label: director of organization
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit director office of, for or at organization or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit director/co-director; functional directorship such as communications or research director within Y; historical office. Excludes: head/president/chair/executive alone; spokesperson/adviser/publisher/professor/member alone; performing or authorship alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal with omitted organization; abstract topic in place of the actual institution. Does not require sole chief control of the entire institution.

prior.label: executive of
prior.definition: The first person holds or held an executive office in the second organization or governmental jurisdiction.
prior.scope_notes: Executive constructions overwhelmingly dominate. Corporate and county executive offices both qualify under the same office relation. Candidacy, nomination, legislation and being hired by an executive alone do not establish tenure; direct historical titles and resignation do.

current.label: executive of
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified executive office in organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: executive/chief executive office; corporate and county executive; explicit historical executive office. Excludes: chair/director/president/head alone without executive title; hired by an executive; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: title/attachment omits who holds the executive office.

prior.label: managerial or leadership office in
prior.definition: The first person holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in the second organization or governing body.
prior.scope_notes: The head/chair/executive/chief family collectively dominates and matches the earlier broad managerial-office scope. Include explicit executive, chair, president, director or equivalent office without requiring sole overall control. Analyst, founder, owner, ordinary employment and a nomination alone are excluded.

current.label: managerial or leadership office in
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

prior.label: president or manager of
prior.definition: The first person holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in the second organization, team or public body.
prior.scope_notes: The president family dominates, with a smaller manager family. Preserve the earlier president-or-manager scope. Generic head, chair, executive, director, coach, athlete or ordinary employment alone is insufficient. Functional presidential roles within an organization count without claiming sole chief presidency; modifiers missing from a path cannot be reconstructed.

current.label: president or manager of
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team, public body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit president or manager title or unambiguous manage-as-office evidence; general manager; borough president and community-board manager; functional presidency within an organization; historical tenure. Excludes: chair/director/executive/head alone; owner/founder/coach/player alone; generic running or control without the specified role; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal replacing omitted organization/campaign; missing title modifier that could change the office. This deliberately composite legacy operational predicate is retained for comparability. Mark manager-only support broad_predicate. It is not a claim that president and manager are interchangeable atomic relations. A narrower president-only sensitivity requires separate complete re-evaluation, not selective changes.

prior.label: political or organizational leader of
prior.definition: The first person is or was a political, organizational or community leader of the group, legislature or political body designated by the second argument.
prior.scope_notes: Leader-of/noun/possessive dominates. Preserve the earlier political-group scope, including legislative majority/minority leadership and adjectival group names when direct leadership paths establish the group connection. A generic political label is not a uniquely named person; incompatible personal names remain identity ambiguities. Do not infer formal state control from spiritual/community leadership or mere founding.

current.label: leader or organizational head of
current.definition: Person X holds or held a leader, head, president, chief or chair office in group, institution, organization or political body Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit leader/head/president/chief/chair; legislative majority/minority leadership or whip; leadership office within an identified body; historical office. Excludes: ordinary membership or service; founding/ownership alone; party control of a chamber; candidate alone; athletic/standings or task-only lead; editor alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic director or executive without clear leadership role; bare lead lacking organizational-role context; materially truncated political body. Preserves the narrower leader/head family used in the two original full censuses; managerial_office_in separately accepts explicit director/executive titles.

prior.label: winner or champion of
prior.definition: The first entity won the competition or award designated by the second, or held its championship title.
prior.scope_notes: Win and winner dominate, using the same scope as rel_112 and the earlier reviews. Reaching or participating in an event, winning only a stage, and winning political office do not establish this competition/award predicate. current.label: winner or champion of

Excludes: participation or reaching the event; single stage/game victory without the overall title; winning political office/control of a body; location or ordinary membership. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear title/event attachment; medal without a clear winning title or award scope. A named boxing body can designate its explicit title; mark broad_predicate rather than claiming the body itself was won. A named electoral competition is conceptually an event, but winning the White House or a legislature is office/control, not event-winning.

prior.label: defeated opponent
prior.definition: The first competitor won a contest against the second competitor.
prior.scope_notes: Beat/defeat/victory dominates, preserving the directed defeated-opponent scope used in rel_114 and earlier audits. Mere play, trade, contract or political/geographical comparison is insufficient. Historical wins and losses can coexist, but ambiguous competitors must still be resolved.

current.label: defeated opponent
current.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
current.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

prior.label: geographical part of
prior.definition: The first named neighborhood, district or area is geographically contained in the second place.
prior.scope_notes: Area/section/neighborhood-of/in strongly dominates. This is a place-to-containing-place relationship, distinct from personal residence, travel, schools or an organization located somewhere. The listed longer paths may be noisy without invalidating clean containment evidence; incompatible neighborhood names require identity review.

current.label: geographical part of
current.definition: Named geographic area, neighborhood or district X is contained within geographic place Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: area/section/neighborhood/district of or in; clear place-to-containing-place attachment. Excludes: organization subsidiary or location; residence/work/travel; an event in a place. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place names attached through an omitted institution.

prior.label: owner of
prior.definition: The first person or organization owns or owned the second property, company, network or team.
prior.scope_notes: Owner/own and corporate parent paths dominate in the owner-to-property direction, matching the earlier ownership scope. Historical ownership counts. Merger, rejected acquisition, chairmanship of an owner, publishing or a bare possessive alone does not establish ownership.

current.label: owns organization or asset
current.definition: Person or organization X owns or owned some or all of organization, business, team or property Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: owner/co-owner/owns; explicit ownership interest or stated share; corporate parent; completed acquisition with ownership attachment; historical ownership. Excludes: management or leadership alone; publishing or distribution alone; mere collaboration; proposed or rejected acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: merger without clear ownership direction; a possessive alone. This states ownership interest, not necessarily complete ownership or control. An explicit partial stake qualifies here but not automatically as subsidiary_of in reverse.

Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: nationality adjective alone; truncated country/place; Wall Street as place versus industry. A shortened organization name may be resolved by its own explicit company/unit role. No location evidence is imported from a different latent fact.

prior.label: winner or champion of
prior.definition: X won competition, race, championship, prize or award Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves event/award winner scope. Event Y differs from a defeated opponent or an issuing organization. Participation, finishing, winning one stage or travel alone does not establish winning the entire event.

current.label: winner or champion of
current.definition: Entity X won the award or competition designated by Y, or held an explicitly Y-designated championship title.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit win/winner/champion of event or award; sporting titles and honor awards such as Nobel Peace Prize; explicit championship/title designated by a sanctioning body or Olympic designation; historical victory. Excludes: participation or reaching the event; single stage/game victory without the overall title; winning political office/control of a body; location or ordinary membership. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear title/event attachment; medal without a clear winning title or award scope. A named boxing body can designate its explicit title; mark broad_predicate rather than claiming the body itself was won. A named electoral competition is conceptually an event, but winning the White House or a legislature is office/control, not event-winning.

prior.label: born in
prior.definition: Person X was born in geographical place Y.
prior.scope_notes: Declare the coherent birthplace meaning from dominant born-in/born-into-family-in paths. Growing up, schooling, residence, nationality, work or later travel alone does not establish birthplace. This is a new explicit meaning where the prior common catalogue has no matching sampled relation.

current.label: born in
current.definition: Person X was born in geographic place Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: direct born-in; born into a family in Y when Y is the birth location. Excludes: grown up/raised/native/from alone; nationality; schooling/residence/travel; institution founding. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear person or birthplace attachment.

prior.label: president or manager of
prior.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or institution Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves the earlier combined president/manager scope. Generic head, leadership, ownership, coach or ordinary employee alone does not establish these offices. Truncated personal-principal arguments may omit a campaign/organization and require review.

current.label: president or manager of
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team, public body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit president or manager title or unambiguous manage-as-office evidence; general manager; borough president and community-board manager; functional presidency within an organization; historical tenure. Excludes: chair/director/executive/head alone; owner/founder/coach/player alone; generic running or control without the specified role; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal replacing omitted organization/campaign; missing title modifier that could change the office. This deliberately composite legacy operational predicate is retained for comparability. Mark manager-only support broad_predicate. It is not a claim that president and manager are interchangeable atomic relations. A narrower president-only sensitivity requires separate complete re-evaluation, not selective changes.

prior.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
prior.definition: Organization or business unit X is a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational part of parent organization Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves prior child-to-parent subsidiary/unit scope. Explicit part, unit, subsidiary or owned-by qualifies. Ordinary employment, a geographic site standing for an unnamed unit, and partial investment alone do not establish the same fact.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
current.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

prior.label: leader or organizational head of
prior.definition: Person X holds or held a leadership or head office in political body or organization Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves prior leader/head scope, including legislative leadership and explicit president/chair office. Simple membership, founding, affiliation, legal representation or an athletic lead does not qualify.

current.label: leader or organizational head of
current.definition: Person X holds or held a leader, head, president, chief or chair office in group, institution, organization or political body Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit leader/head/president/chief/chair; legislative majority/minority leadership or whip; leadership office within an identified body; historical office. Excludes: ordinary membership or service; founding/ownership alone; party control of a chamber; candidate alone; athletic/standings or task-only lead; editor alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic director or executive without clear leadership role; bare lead lacking organizational-role context; materially truncated political body. Preserves the narrower leader/head family used in the two original full censuses; managerial_office_in separately accepts explicit director/executive titles.

prior.label: managerial or leadership office in
prior.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, such as chairperson, head, director, president, manager, chief or executive.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves prior organizational office family. The dictionary combines qualifying offices; founder, owner, analyst, ordinary employment or sporting lead alone is insufficient. Historical offices qualify.

current.label: managerial or leadership office in
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

prior.scope_notes: Preserves prior child-to-parent subsidiary/unit scope. Explicit part, unit, subsidiary or owned-by qualifies. Ordinary employment, a geographic site standing for an unnamed unit, and partial investment alone do not establish the same fact.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of

current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. prior.label: defeated opponent
prior.definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves prior winner-to-opponent scope. Beat, defeat, completed sweep, outscore or victory over qualifies. Playing, facing, standings, losing, trades or transfers alone do not. A historical win remains supported when other rows describe losses; flag the mixed evidence.

current.label: defeated opponent
current.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
current.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

prior.label: managerial or leadership office in
prior.definition: X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, such as head, leader, president, manager, director, executive or chair.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves prior managerial/leadership office scope, including public executive roles. Founding, ownership, ordinary employment, campaigning or sporting lead alone is insufficient. Competing predicates are retained as errors, not added to the definition.

current.label: managerial or leadership office in
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

prior.label: defeated opponent
prior.definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves winner-to-opponent scope. Beat, defeat and victory over qualify. Playing/facing, standings, losing, communication and professional affiliation alone do not. A historical win remains support when other rows describe losses. The dictionary strongly mixes contest outcomes with directed communication; beat/defeat are its two most frequent paths. The chosen contest predicate is not uniquely compelled by this mixed cluster.

current.label: defeated opponent
current.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
current.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

prior.label: economist at organization
prior.definition: Person X is an economist at, for, with or of organization Y.
prior.scope_notes: Economist is the most frequent specific occupational path family. Professors, analysts, directors and other employment compete substantially; preserve the specific economist meaning instead of accepting any affiliation.

current.label: economist at organization
current.definition: Person X works or worked as an economist for or affiliated with organization Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit economist at/for/with/of; historical departmental economist affiliation. Excludes: analyst/strategist/specialist/professor/executive alone; generic financial expertise. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear economist/employer attachment.

prior.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
prior.definition: Organization or business unit X is a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational part of parent Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves subsidiary/unit scope. Explicit unit, part, subsidiary or owned-by qualifies. Distinct latent facts with identical literal names remain separate under the preregistered population; this does not validate their splitting.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
current.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

prior.label: travels or moves to
prior.definition: Person, group or organization X travels, visits, arrives, returns or relocates to geographical place Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves travel/relocation scope. Event participation, residence, death place, datelines and general association alone do not qualify; a relocation mentioned only as a potential move needs modal review.

current.label: moves or travels to
current.definition: Person, group or organization X undertakes movement with geographic destination Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: move/relocate/return/arrive/go/visit to Y; depart/leave for Y; temporary travel or organizational relocation; bare unqualified destination movement as textual support. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: explicitly hypothetical or proposed relocation; invasion-only boundary; geographic/team or theatrical metonymy. current.label: winner or champion of
current.definition: Entity X won the award or competition designated by Y, or held an explicitly Y-designated championship title.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit win/winner/champion of event or award; sporting titles and honor awards such as Nobel Peace Prize; explicit championship/title designated by a sanctioning body or Olympic designation; historical victory. A named electoral competition is conceptually an event, but winning the White House or a legislature is office/control, not event-winning.

prior.definition: X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, such as head, leader, president, manager, director, executive or chair.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves prior managerial/leadership office scope, including public executive roles. Founding, ownership, ordinary employment, campaigning or sporting lead alone is insufficient. Competing predicates are retained as errors, not added to the definition. The full leading distribution includes leader/chief/chair office paths alongside a strong spokesman family, lawyers, accusations and residence. Office is declared without adding those competing roles.

current.label: managerial or leadership office in
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

prior.label: organization based or located in
prior.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographical place Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves organization-location scope. Firm-in, based-in and headquarters evidence qualify; industry, a person birthplace, officeholders and unspecified nationality do not. Incompatible merged entity names require identity review.

current.label: organization based or located in
current.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: based/headquarters/campus/office in; company/firm/group in a place; clear company/firm geographic noun modifiers; historical organizational location. Excludes: industry/Internet or corporate-family/Bell association; person birthplace/residence/occupation; mere event location; ownership or employment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: nationality adjective alone; truncated country/place; Wall Street as place versus industry. A shortened organization name may be resolved by its own explicit company/unit role. No location evidence is imported from a different latent fact.

prior.label: directed communication to
prior.definition: X communicates a request, information, message, advice or testimony to addressee Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves ask/tell/urge/send/notify directed-communication scope. Co-occurrence, bare political criticism, possession and standings do not qualify. Non-alias source people merged in one entity require identity review even if both communicate.

current.label: directed communication to
current.definition: Person or institution X directs information, speech, request, advice, warning or a message to addressee Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: tell/ask/urge/notify/advise/warn/persuade/address/speak-to; testimony before the addressee; send/submit a clearly communicative object; institutional communication through an identified representative. Excludes: mere meeting/cooperation/support; speaking about or criticizing Y without address; physical transfer; spokesperson intermediary treated as recipient. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: send/submit/give with omitted object and no other clear communication in this fact; person versus their administration or envoy attribution. An unqualified send-to edge does not by itself recover a message. Case-local corroboration may resolve it.

prior.label: winner or champion of
prior.definition: X won competition, race, championship, prize or award Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves event/award winner scope. Y is the event or award, not a defeated opponent, political office, general venue or issuing organization unless the event referent is recoverable. Presence and participation alone do not qualify. The distribution substantially mixes event winning with travel/presence and political control; do not broaden winner to all in/go-to associations.

current.label: winner or champion of
current.definition: Entity X won the award or competition designated by Y, or held an explicitly Y-designated championship title.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit win/winner/champion of event or award; sporting titles and honor awards such as Nobel Peace Prize; explicit championship/title designated by a sanctioning body or Olympic designation; historical victory. Excludes: participation or reaching the event; single stage/game victory without the overall title; winning political office/control of a body; location or ordinary membership. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear title/event attachment; medal without a clear winning title or award scope. A named boxing body can designate its explicit title; mark broad_predicate rather than claiming the body itself was won. A named electoral competition is conceptually an event, but winning the White House or a legislature is office/control, not event-winning.

prior.label: analyst at organization
prior.definition: Person X is an analyst at, with or for organization Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves analyst-specific affiliation. Other offices, ownership, corporate unit and political control are outside scope.

current.label: analyst at organization
current.definition: Person X works or worked as an analyst for organization Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit analyst at/for/with/of; following or tracking an industry or companies for an employer when it identifies professional analysis. Excludes: director/president/professor/scientist/spokesperson/editor/lawyer/partner alone; generic affiliation. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: economist-only, forecaster, strategist or specialist at the analyst role boundary; unclear role/employer attachment. Preserves the earlier full-census A boundary for nearby financial roles; do not silently label all financial employment analyst.

prior.label: owns or is parent of
prior.definition: Person or organization X owns business, organization or property Y, or is its corporate parent.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves ownership/parent scope, allowing personal owners and properties. Officeholding, political association, travel and criminal-case location do not suffice.

current.label: owns organization or asset
current.definition: Person or organization X owns or owned some or all of organization, business, team or property Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: owner/co-owner/owns; explicit ownership interest or stated share; corporate parent; completed acquisition with ownership attachment; historical ownership. Excludes: management or leadership alone; publishing or distribution alone; mere collaboration; proposed or rejected acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: merger without clear ownership direction; a possessive alone. This states ownership interest, not necessarily complete ownership or control. An explicit partial stake qualifies here but not automatically as subsidiary_of in reverse.

prior.label: director of organization
prior.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit director office in organization or institution Y.
prior.scope_notes: Director-specific role declared from the leading dictionary family. Head/president, founder, ordinary employment and birthplace alone are not equivalent. Co-director qualifies; title modifiers without a complete referent require review.

current.label: director of organization
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit director office of, for or at organization or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit director/co-director; functional directorship such as communications or research director within Y; historical office. Excludes: head/president/chair/executive alone; spokesperson/adviser/publisher/professor/member alone; performing or authorship alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal with omitted organization; abstract topic in place of the actual institution. Does not require sole chief control of the entire institution.

prior.label: has political or institutional leader
prior.definition: Political body or institution X has person Y as leader, president, minister or head.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves inverse political-leadership scope. Explicit minister office is included. Forward person-to-body leadership, mere presence and resignation without an office are not the same ordered relation.

current.label: political body has a leader
current.definition: Country, political body or legislature X has or had person Y as a political leader.
current.scope_notes: Includes: national president/ruler/head of government; named parliamentary majority/minority leader or whip; historical leadership. Excludes: corporate/team leadership; ordinary membership/meeting; party control instead of an individual leader; person-to-body forward direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unspecified minister without evidence of head-of-government or leadership scope; truncated body or unnamed officeholder. Harmonizes the later minister-inclusive samples to the original full-census scope. An unspecified minister alone is A, not automatically S.

prior.label: spokesperson for
prior.definition: Person X is spokesperson for organization, office or person Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves spokesperson/speak-for scope and direction. Other roles, reversed legal representation, corporate location and contest outcomes do not qualify.

current.label: spokesperson for
current.definition: Person X serves or served as spokesperson for principal Y, which may be a person, organization or public office.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit spokesman/spokeswoman/spokesperson; expressly speaking for principal; representation through an identified principal office. Excludes: director/president/adviser/aide/lobbyist/secretary alone; communicating to rather than for Y; forward principal-to-person direction. prior.label: defeated opponent
prior.definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest; direction is winner to defeated opponent.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves the previous defeated-opponent predicate. Explicit beat, defeat, victory over or completed sweep qualify. Losing, playing, facing, trading or standings alone do not. Different historical games can supply both wins and losses; a clear win supports the fact but other assignments remain mixed evidence.

current.label: defeated opponent
current.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
current.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

prior.label: analyst at organization

current.label: analyst at organization

Preserves the earlier full-census A boundary for nearby financial roles; do not silently label all financial employment analyst.

prior.label: president or manager of
prior.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or institution Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves the earlier combined president/manager scope. Explicit historical office qualifies. Generic leader, running/control, director, chairman, founder, owner, coach or athlete leadership alone does not establish either specified office. Manager cases are marked as the deliberately broader role family.

current.label: president or manager of
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team, public body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit president or manager title or unambiguous manage-as-office evidence; general manager; borough president and community-board manager; functional presidency within an organization; historical tenure. Excludes: chair/director/executive/head alone; owner/founder/coach/player alone; generic running or control without the specified role; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal replacing omitted organization/campaign; missing title modifier that could change the office. This deliberately composite legacy operational predicate is retained for comparability. Mark manager-only support broad_predicate. It is not a claim that president and manager are interchangeable atomic relations. A narrower president-only sensitivity requires separate complete re-evaluation, not selective changes.

current.label: managerial or leadership office in
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. prior.definition: X holds or held a leadership/head role in political body or organization Y.

current.label: leader or organizational head of

current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit leader/head/president/chief/chair; legislative majority/minority leadership or whip; leadership office within an identified body; historical office. Excludes: ordinary membership or service; founding/ownership alone; party control of a chamber; candidate alone; athletic/standings or task-only lead; editor alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic director or executive without clear leadership role; bare lead lacking organizational-role context; materially truncated political body. prior.label: winner or champion of
prior.definition: X won competition, race, championship, prize or award Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves the earlier winner/champion scope, with Y the event or award, not the defeated opponent. Teams, people and racehorses can win. Participation or finishing alone is not sufficient; a historical win qualifies.

current.label: winner or champion of
current.definition: Entity X won the award or competition designated by Y, or held an explicitly Y-designated championship title.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit win/winner/champion of event or award; sporting titles and honor awards such as Nobel Peace Prize; explicit championship/title designated by a sanctioning body or Olympic designation; historical victory. Excludes: participation or reaching the event; single stage/game victory without the overall title; winning political office/control of a body; location or ordinary membership. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear title/event attachment; medal without a clear winning title or award scope. A named boxing body can designate its explicit title; mark broad_predicate rather than claiming the body itself was won. A named electoral competition is conceptually an event, but winning the White House or a legislature is office/control, not event-winning.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of

current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. prior.label: defeated opponent
prior.definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest, including an electoral contest; direction is winner to defeated opponent.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves the prior defeated-opponent scope. Explicit beat, defeat, victory over, trounce or completed elimination qualifies. Playing, facing, losing, standings, trading or political criticism alone do not. Both a win and a loss across historical games can be true; mixed assignments remain flagged.

current.label: defeated opponent
current.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
current.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

prior.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
prior.definition: Organization or business unit X is a subsidiary, organizational part, division or owned business of parent organization Y.
prior.scope_notes: Preserves the earlier subsidiary/unit scope. Explicit owned-by, unit, part or subsidiary evidence qualifies. Geography, ordinary employment and partial investment alone do not. A location standing for an unnamed office would remain ambiguous.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
current.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

current.label: president or manager of

current.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. current.label: directed communication to
current.definition: Person or institution X directs information, speech, request, advice, warning or a message to addressee Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: tell/ask/urge/notify/advise/warn/persuade/address/speak-to; testimony before the addressee; send/submit a clearly communicative object; institutional communication through an identified representative. Excludes: mere meeting/cooperation/support; speaking about or criticizing Y without address; physical transfer; spokesperson intermediary treated as recipient. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: send/submit/give with omitted object and no other clear communication in this fact; person versus their administration or envoy attribution. current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

prior.label: managerial or organizational leader of
prior.definition: Person X holds a managerial or organizational leadership office in organization or political body Y.
prior.scope_notes: President, leader, head, manager and executive paths dominate. This preserves the prior broad leadership scope, including historical office. Truncated political labels remain identity ambiguities; mere membership and event attendance do not suffice.

current.label: managerial or leadership office in
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

prior.label: organization based or located in
prior.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
prior.scope_notes: Based-in, headquarters-in and geographic company/firm descriptions dominate, preserving the prior organizational-location scope. Geographic noun modifiers qualify for firms; subject-matter or industry modifiers and personal/event locations alone do not.

current.label: organization based or located in
current.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: based/headquarters/campus/office in; company/firm/group in a place; clear company/firm geographic noun modifiers; historical organizational location. Excludes: industry/Internet or corporate-family/Bell association; person birthplace/residence/occupation; mere event location; ownership or employment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: nationality adjective alone; truncated country/place; Wall Street as place versus industry. A shortened organization name may be resolved by its own explicit company/unit role. No location evidence is imported from a different latent fact.

prior.label: managerial or organizational leader of
prior.definition: Person X holds a managerial or organizational leadership office in organization or political body Y.
prior.scope_notes: Chairman, head, executive and leader paths dominate, preserving the prior broad leadership scope. Founder, ownership and ordinary membership alone are separate relations. Party adjectives and party-labelled unnamed persons remain identity ambiguities.

current.label: managerial or leadership office in
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

prior.label: directed communication to
prior.definition: X directs an utterance, request, warning or explicit message to Y.
prior.scope_notes: Tell, urge, ask, notify and speak-to give the directed-communication component, preserving prior scope. Accusing or speaking about someone is insufficient without evidence of address. Sending an unspecified object alone is ambiguous; institutional speech through representatives is allowed.

current.label: directed communication to
current.definition: Person or institution X directs information, speech, request, advice, warning or a message to addressee Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: tell/ask/urge/notify/advise/warn/persuade/address/speak-to; testimony before the addressee; send/submit a clearly communicative object; institutional communication through an identified representative. Excludes: mere meeting/cooperation/support; speaking about or criticizing Y without address; physical transfer; spokesperson intermediary treated as recipient. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: send/submit/give with omitted object and no other clear communication in this fact; person versus their administration or envoy attribution. An unqualified send-to edge does not by itself recover a message. Case-local corroboration may resolve it.

prior.label: spokesperson for
prior.definition: Person X serves as a spokesperson or expressly speaks for person or organization Y.
prior.scope_notes: Spokesman/spokeswoman is the strongest recurring specific role and preserves the prior spokesperson predicate. This cluster also contains a substantial broader managerial/director component; those offices alone do not imply a spokesperson role, and this scope does not union them. Predicate choice is material in this mixed cluster.

current.label: spokesperson for
current.definition: Person X serves or served as spokesperson for principal Y, which may be a person, organization or public office.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit spokesman/spokeswoman/spokesperson; expressly speaking for principal; representation through an identified principal office. Excludes: director/president/adviser/aide/lobbyist/secretary alone; communicating to rather than for Y; forward principal-to-person direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: geographic dateline replacing the person; unclear represented principal.

prior.label: analyst at

prior.scope_notes: Analyst-at/with/for dominates, preserving the prior analyst scope. Professorship, directorship or expertise alone does not establish an analyst role; these form competing components.

current.label: analyst at organization

current.label: winner or champion of

current.label: coach of
current.definition: Person X coaches or coached sports team or collegiate athletic program Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit coach title; direct coaching with correct subject and team; former/dismissed coach with clear office evidence; team/university shorthand when the athletic program role is clear. Excludes: manager/president/player alone; winning with a team alone; vacancy consideration alone; reverse team-to-coach direction. prior.label: directed communication to

current.label: directed communication to
current.definition: Person or institution X directs information, speech, request, advice, warning or a message to addressee Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: tell/ask/urge/notify/advise/warn/persuade/address/speak-to; testimony before the addressee; send/submit a clearly communicative object; institutional communication through an identified representative. Excludes: mere meeting/cooperation/support; speaking about or criticizing Y without address; physical transfer; spokesperson intermediary treated as recipient. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: send/submit/give with omitted object and no other clear communication in this fact; person versus their administration or envoy attribution. An unqualified send-to edge does not by itself recover a message. Case-local corroboration may resolve it.

prior.label: departed from
prior.definition: Person or organization X leaves or withdraws physically from geographic place Y.
prior.scope_notes: This diffuse cluster mixes departure, arrival, legal occupation, publication and residence paths. Leave, withdraw-from, withdrawal and pull-out collectively define the selected coherent departure component. Arrival is a competing direction and residence is a different predicate; neither is unioned into it. No uniquely dominant interpretation is guaranteed, so relation-level predicate choice is a material caveat.

current.label: departed from
current.definition: Person, group or organization X physically leaves or withdraws from geographic place Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: leave/withdraw/pull out from Y; historical physical departure. Excludes: arrival/return to Y; residence alone; leaving a job or team as an institution without geography. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place versus institution as source; explicitly conditional departure.

prior.label: owns
prior.definition: Person or organization X owns organization or asset Y.
prior.scope_notes: Own, owner, parent, company-of and acquisition paths collectively form the largest coherent ownership component, preserving the prior ownership direction. Birthplace is a prominent competing component with the two highest individual path counts; it is not unioned with ownership. Location of premises alone is insufficient and proposed/rejected acquisitions alone would be ambiguous.

current.label: owns organization or asset
current.definition: Person or organization X owns or owned some or all of organization, business, team or property Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: owner/co-owner/owns; explicit ownership interest or stated share; corporate parent; completed acquisition with ownership attachment; historical ownership. Excludes: management or leadership alone; publishing or distribution alone; mere collaboration; proposed or rejected acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: merger without clear ownership direction; a possessive alone. This states ownership interest, not necessarily complete ownership or control. An explicit partial stake qualifies here but not automatically as subsidiary_of in reverse.

prior.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
prior.definition: Organization X is owned by, a subsidiary of, or an organizational unit of parent Y.
prior.scope_notes: Unit, part, subsidiary and owned-by define the child-to-parent containment predicate, retaining prior scope. This cluster includes many office-location attachments: a city label may be shorthand for an omitted local office, but the literal city is not the organizational unit, so those cases require identity clarification.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
current.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

prior.label: has organizational or political leader

current.label: has organizational or political leader

current.scope_notes: Includes: inverse of managerial_office_in with an explicit office; corporate or political institutions; historical office. Excludes: ordinary membership; geographic co-occurrence; interactions without office; forward person-to-body direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: incomplete principal or office attachment. prior.label: organization based or located in
prior.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.

current.label: organization based or located in
current.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: based/headquarters/campus/office in; company/firm/group in a place; clear company/firm geographic noun modifiers; historical organizational location. Excludes: industry/Internet or corporate-family/Bell association; person birthplace/residence/occupation; mere event location; ownership or employment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: nationality adjective alone; truncated country/place; Wall Street as place versus industry. A shortened organization name may be resolved by its own explicit company/unit role. No location evidence is imported from a different latent fact.

prior.label: managerial or leadership office in
prior.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or political body Y.
prior.scope_notes: Head, president, leader, chair, dean, director or executive roles qualify, including offices within an organization. Professors, experts, scientists, generic employment, founding and spokesperson roles alone do not. Historical tenure counts.

current.label: managerial or leadership office in
current.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

prior.label: defeated opponent
prior.definition: Competitor X defeated opposing competitor Y in a completed sporting or electoral contest.
prior.scope_notes: Beat, defeat, sweep, outlast, rout, upset and explicit victories qualify. Mere playing, facing, standings leads, transfers and losses do not. Historical win evidence suffices even with other losses; geographic team metonymy needs clear competitive roles.

current.label: defeated opponent
current.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
current.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

prior.scope_notes: Chair, executive, head, chief and equivalent leadership qualify. Founder, owner, partner, generic employment, meetings and nomination alone do not establish tenure; historical office counts.

current.label: spokesperson for

prior.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
prior.definition: Organization X is a subsidiary, division or organizational unit of Y.
prior.scope_notes: Explicit unit, subsidiary, division, parent or owned-by qualify, including historical ownership. Mere affiliation, employee roles, geographic places and reverse ownership do not. City-as-office metonymy requires review.

current.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
current.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

current.label: analyst at organization
current.definition: Person X works or worked as an analyst for organization Y.
current.scope_notes: Includes: explicit analyst at/for/with/of; following or tracking an industry or companies for an employer when it identifies professional analysis. Excludes: director/president/professor/scientist/spokesperson/editor/lawyer/partner alone; generic affiliation. Preserves the earlier full-census A boundary for nearby financial roles; do not silently label all financial employment analyst.

prior.label: winner or champion of
